findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the TR-1s are public and the stock has run +22.85% over 60 days. What is left is a persistent buyer of size absorbing supply on a disappointing headline in a $0.9m/day stock; if that were fully priced, the share would not still sit 30%+ below the 435-510p broker targets. Small, positioning only, no bid implied and no Rule 2 announcement.
findings.independence: Earlier steps in the same build: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/bzw/next-15-group--nfg/holding-s-in-company/9732942 and /9710920 and /9689433 (same holder, same channel, so not independent evidence about the print).

findings.finding: Peers that reported after Next 15's 8 Jul update confirm technology clients are still cutting marketing opex: S4 Capital (5 Aug) cited tech clients/hyperscalers prioritising AI capex over marketing with FY LFL net revenue down mid-single digits, and WPP H1 (Aug) had Tech & Digital Services still declining LFL in Q2 - a drag on Next 15's B2B tech marketing agencies (Pretzl, Track 2).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Tech client weakness drove the -28.0% June 2025 warning (with Mach49) and the -11.1% Apr 2025 finals; since the reset, 'subdued tech' commentary has come with in-line statements moving -0.7% and -2.9%.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely inside guidance: Next 15 itself said on 8 Jul that the 'market backdrop for its B2B tech focused agencies remain[s] subdued' and still called trading in line. If this were unpriced the stock would not have rallied through August after both peer prints. Residual is the risk the B2B tech pocket worsened in Jun-Jul beyond what 'in line' allowed for; proxy evidence, sized small.
findings.independence: WPP H1 2026: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/rns/wpp--wpp/2026-interim-results/9707289 (Tech & Digital Services LFL decline continued in Q2, but group Q2 improved to -2.8% from -6.7%).

findings.finding: The Defra ADMS+ call-off on which Transform is lead delivery partner via i10 is a £150m ceiling award (one of three £150m lots), adding to the 4-year DfE contract won in December 2025 - support for H1 like-for-like growth in Digital Transformation, which grew 41.8% in FY26.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Digital Transformation strength carried the +14.3% reaction to the Sep 2025 interims (DT up >50%) and featured in the +6.8% May 2026 finals.
findings.source_date: 2026-01 (award notice; date not confirmed on the page, snippet_only)
findings.why_not_priced: The win itself was announced by the company on 8 Jul and sits inside the 'in line' statement; the ceiling value is a framework maximum, not revenue, and Transform's share of it is unknown. Only the residual upside of a faster ramp than the market models remains, so small.
findings.independence: Company statement of the role: https://www.investegate.co.uk/announcement/bzw/next-15-group--nfg/trading-statement/9657126 (same fact, company side).

findings.finding: The FY26 accounts carry a going-concern material uncertainty arising solely from the Mach49 arbitration (former owners claim the remaining earnout, reported at US$219m; £68.9m contingent consideration on balance sheet), with the outcome 'expected to be known within the next 12 months' of 7 May 2026 - the interim statement must update it and an outcome either way would dominate the day.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Mach49 misconduct disclosure was part of the -28.0% move on 26 Jun 2025; no ruling has been announced since; 8 Jul 2026 update ('remains ongoing') moved -2.9%.
findings.original_quote: the outcome of the arbitration, which is expected to be known within the next 12 months, is inherently difficult to predict. The Board cannot entirely exclude the possibility of a material adverse financial outcome which could exceed the current forecast liquidity in the longer term.
findings.why_not_priced: Not directional: no ruling, hearing date or settlement has been reported anywhere I could reach, so the sign cannot be called; the stock trades well below broker targets partly because of this overhang. Filed at 0 with a wide two-sided range; it is the main reason abs_move_pct is above the pre-released base.
findings.independence: Claim size US$219m: https://globalarbitrationreview.com/article/business-consultancy-faces-post-ma-claim (2025-09-08); 8 Jul 2026 RNS says arbitration 'remains ongoing'.

lessons_applied: 'A finding about a number the market has already been told is worth 0': the Transform/Defra finding and the tech-peer finding both land inside the 8 Jul 'in line' statement, so +0.3 -> +0.2 and -0.4 -> -0.3.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction': Griffiths' stake is a verified fact with no clear path to the print reaction, +0.4 -> +0.3.

'You were right about the number and too small about the move' / reaction history vetoes direction not size: abs_move_pct 6.0 -> 6.5, since H1 numbers and a Mach49 update are new and last year's interims moved +14.3%; p_up left at 51.
